test_name: Physical and Environmental Protection - PE-3 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Reporting-Service-107
Primary NIST family: Physical and Environmental Protection (PE); evidence focus: PE-3.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: visitor access is escorted, logged, time-bounded, and retained for review. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
